description: Settle outstanding compute balance to upgrade Bayesian reputation score and dynamically expand credit ceiling. Supports payment reference or gasless EIP-3009 transfer authorization.

amount.description: Amount in USD to settle (omit to settle entire outstanding balance).

eip3009.description: Optional gasless EIP-3009 authorization signature payload (from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce, v, r, s).

payment_reference.description: Payment receipt, transaction hash, or off-chain authorization reference.
